An '''anti-grav chair''' was a personal conveyance used by individuals who found standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] worlds uncomfortable and difficult to move in. [[Ellam]] used an anti-grav chair to move around on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Questal/Legends|Questal]].
